days.label: Push Day ? Chest, Shoulders & Triceps
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + arm circles + band pull-aparts

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 135 ? push day was not logged this week. No log means no data, and no data means no progress. You went 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/9 on Aug 27 ? that was the last confirmed session ? and we still need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 140. Touch the chest, pause a full second, drive through the heels, stay braced from rep one to the last. Take all 90 seconds of rest. Log this Monday. No more missing push days.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 45 ? push day was not logged this week. Last confirmed was 10/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8. You are hitting the reps but the effort cost is still too high. 30-degree incline, elbows at 45, 2-second negative. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 50. You have been one clean session away from this bump for two weeks now.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 35 ? push day was not logged this week so there is no data from last week at this weight. You bumped up to 35 from 30 this week based on earning it the week before. Now I need to see what 35 actually costs you. Press straight up, full lockout, no lean back. Aim for 8-10 reps at RPE 7 across all three sets. Log every set. This is still first confirmed session at 35.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Staying at 15 ? push day was not logged this week. Last confirmed was 10/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8. Still stuck at the bottom of the rep range with too-high effort. Slight elbow bend, lead with the elbows, 2-second hold at the top, slow the negative ? if you are swinging the weight up, that is why you are stuck at 10. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 7 to earn 20.

exercises.name: Close-Grip Bench Press
exercises.notes: Staying at 95 ? push day was not logged this week. Last confirmed was 10/10/10 at RPE 7/8/8 from two weeks ago. Sets 2 and 3 were still at RPE 8. Hands shoulder-width, elbows tucked, lower to the chest, full lockout every rep. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 across all three to earn 100.

exercises.name: Tricep Rope Pushdown
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out dumbbell overhead tricep extension this week and bringing back the rope pushdown. You had the overhead extension in last week but push day was not logged so there is no baseline. We will return to the overhead extension in a future rotation. Rope attachment at the cable, elbows pinned to your sides, split the rope at the bottom, full extension on every rep. Pick a weight where you can hit 10-12 reps at RPE 7. Log the weight you use ? this is a baseline session.

days.cooldown: Stretch chest, shoulders, and triceps ? 5 min

days.label: Pull Day ? Back, Biceps & Rear Delts
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + band pull-aparts + cat-cow stretches

exercises.name: Barbell Deadlift
exercises.notes: Staying at 195 ? you finally logged pull day this week and it was a solid session: 10/8/8 at RPE 7/8/8. Set 1 was great ? 10 reps at RPE 7 is exactly what we need. Sets 2 and 3 dropped to 8 reps and RPE climbed to 8. You are trending the right direction but you need all three sets at 8+ reps with RPE at 7 or lower, or 10/10/10, to earn 205. Lats tight before you break the floor, bar dragging up the shins, breathing reset between every rep. Take the full 2 minutes.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.notes: Staying at 110 ? pull day was not logged for lat pulldown this week even though you showed up Wednesday. Last confirmed data is 10/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8 from several weeks back. You logged 5 exercises Wednesday but this one was missing. That is a gap. Wide grip, pull to upper chest, hard lat squeeze at the bottom, stay upright ? do not row it down. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 120. Log all three sets this week.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Single-Arm Row
exercises.notes: DOWN to 55 ? you logged 50 lbs this week at 10/10/10 at RPE 7/8/8. Wait ? you were prescribed 55 and logged 50. That means you went lighter than prescribed. The prescription is 55 and it stays at 55. If you picked up the 50s by mistake, that explains the sets feeling manageable. This week, hit 55 as prescribed: one hand on the bench, pull to your hip, full squeeze at the top for one second, slow the negative. Strap up if grip is an issue. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 60.

exercises.name: Cable Face Pull
exercises.notes: Staying at 70 ? you logged 12/12/12 at RPE 8/8/8 this week. In range but at the bottom of the rep range and RPE was 8 across the board. Rope at upper pulley, pull to your face, thumbs pointing behind you at the finish, elbows high, full external rotation. Need 15/15/15 at RPE 7 to earn 75. Do not jump weight on your own ? you tried that before.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: Staying at 30 ? you logged 10/10/10 at RPE 7/7/8 this week. Sets 1 and 2 were clean at RPE 7, set 3 crept to 8. Reps were at the top of the range which is great. One more week ? need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 across all three sets to earn 35. Neutral grip, elbows pinned, no swinging, full curl, controlled negative. You are close.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
exercises.notes: ROTATION IN ? swapping out EZ bar curl this week to give the biceps a break from curling volume after running both hammer curl and EZ bar curl together. Straight-arm pulldown is a great lat isolator that does not compete with what the rest of the pull day is already doing. Bar attachment at the high pulley, arms straight throughout ? do not bend the elbows ? drive the bar down to your thighs, hold the lat squeeze for a second at the bottom, controlled return. Pick a weight where 10-12 reps is RPE 7. Log the weight ? this is a baseline session. We will bring EZ bar curl back in the next pull rotation.

days.cooldown: Stretch lats, biceps, and upper back ? 5 min

days.label: Leg Day ? Quads, Hamstrings, Glutes & Core
days.warmup: 5 min light cardio + bodyweight squats + leg swings

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.notes: Staying at 165 ? you went 8/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8 again this week. Same result as last week: in range, but stuck at the bottom and effort is still high. You are working it but not making progress. Below parallel, big breath before you unrack, brace hard, drive through the heels, chest up out of the hole, take the full 2 minutes between sets. Need 9-10 reps on all three sets at RPE 7 or under to earn 175. You have been at 165 long enough ? this is the week to push the rep count.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Staying at 155 ? you went 10/8/8 at RPE 8/8/8 this week. Set 1 was strong but sets 2 and 3 dropped back to 8 reps and RPE held at 8 across the board. The fatigue is real on this one coming after squats. Slight knee bend, hips back, bar close to the legs, feel the hamstring stretch at the bottom, do not let the lower back round. Need 10/10/10 at RPE 7 to earn 165.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Staying at 30 ? you went 10/10/10 at RPE 8/8/8 again this week. This is a pattern: every session at 30 lbs is the same result. You are consistent but you are not pushing the rep ceiling. Rear foot on the bench, drop straight down, front shin vertical, drive through the front heel. You have more in you ? stop racking it at 10. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 7 to earn 35. This needs to change this week.

exercises.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: Staying at 85 ? you went 12/12/12 at RPE 7/7/8 this week. Sets 1 and 2 were excellent ? 12 reps at RPE 7. Set 3 crept to RPE 8. Very close to earning 90. Upper back on the bench, drive through the heels, full hip extension, hard squeeze at the top for a full second, controlled descent. Need 12/12/12 at RPE 7 across all three sets ? set 3 is the one to watch. You are one tighter session away from the bump.

exercises.name: Leg Curl
exercises.notes: Staying at 55 ? you only logged one set this week (Set 1: 15 reps at RPE 7). Sets 2 and 3 were missing from the log. One set is not enough to evaluate or progress. The prescription is three sets. This week, complete and log all three. Curl the heels toward the glutes, full ROM, controlled return ? no jerking. Need 15/15/15 at RPE 7 to earn 60. Do not cut the session short.

exercises.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
exercises.notes: Staying ? ab wheel rollout was prescribed last week but legs was logged and the rollout was not in the log. No baseline yet. From your knees, roll out until your body is parallel to the floor or as far as you can go with a neutral spine, then pull back ? do not let the hips sag. A barbell on the floor works if you do not have a wheel. Aim for 8-10 reps at RPE 7-8 across all three sets. This is still baseline week. Log all three sets.

days.cooldown: Stretch quads, hamstrings, hip flexors ? 5 min
